title: Retrieve, filter, and plot G-TROPIC global tropical cyclone exposure data at ADM2/daily resolution (1980-present)
text: gtropic_data() function returns named list tables default includes: wind – one row per administrative unit per storm, pairs wind exposure non-zero. core exposure table. precip – one row per administrative unit per local calendar date, dates falling near storm’s passage ADM2. flood – one row per observed flood event. pop – population population-weighted centroid data, per ADM2 per year. adm2 – lookup table administrative units. codebook – dataset’s documentation, nested list. links – see . Three tables available request via tables argument: zero_pairs (unit-storm pairs measurable wind), tracks (raw storm track observations, plotting purposes), geometry (administrative boundaries, plotting purposes, requiring sf package). Every result also carries manifest providing record published files went result, including paths, dataset versions, sizes checksums. Saving lets reproduce retrieval months later, even dataset since revised.
